summary: The first-run setup wizard's deployment-mode step can now fix a failing shared-cache/shared-lock check in place instead of only reporting it: a 'Point this instance at Redis' form tests the connection, saves it through the existing settings API, and prompts for the restart, clearing both rows with one save since they come from the same Redis (the Settings screen's copy of the same panel is unchanged and stays read-only). The node-adoption step no longer dead-ends when no fleet key has ever been set - it now generates one inline instead of sending the operator to the Nodes page and back. Also fixes two defects found while building this: every toast raised by the setup wizard or the forced-password-change screen was silently dropped because those screens render before the app shell that owns the toast stack, and the kind-picker tiles (building/outdoor area/point asset) rendered as an unstyled fused bar in the wizard because their CSS lived in a stylesheet only the fleet map loaded (moved to its own shared stylesheet, asset-kind.css). Also gitignores apps/*/clips/ (event-clip runtime output pulled from nodes), alongside the existing apps/*/recordings/ rule.
compatibility: Backward-compatible. No new required steps: an install that already completed setup, or that skips the deployment/node steps, behaves exactly as before. The Redis setup form only renders when a shared-cache/shared-lock check is actually failing (or right after it was just used), and only inside the wizard - Settings' Deployment panel is untouched. No config default or API contract changes for existing installs.
